rows.text: CodeWiki enforces a gated state machine, not a one-way happy path: each loop may route backward to the smallest upstream loop when doubts, missing definitions, failed checks, or unapproved semantics appear. Lower-layer mutation requires the previous loop's build plus gateway pass, except explicit mechanical/runtime/generated exemptions.
rows.rationale: Compiler promotion gates and backwards routing are one foundational implementation unit.
rows.evidence: TASK-038 acceptance covers decision/planning/implementation preflight enforcement and ambiguity back-routes.

rows.text: Decision gateway requires every approved semantic row to map to updated product/system KB or a named explicit deferral/no-op rationale with owner, trigger, and diagram impact evidence. Planning-only roadmap work is allowed only when decision build proves no durable KB change is needed.
rows.rationale: Decision KB/diagram mapping enforcement belongs in gateway/preflight task with row/action checks.
rows.evidence: TASK-038 includes upstream evidence requirements and validation boundary checks.

rows.text: Planning, implementation, resume, and agency must treat ambiguity as a first-class routing state: if a requirement is not unequivocally defined in the accepted/validated decision build and KB, the agent creates a decision-question surface, blocks the current lower loop, and asks the user to approve/edit/reject/defer the missing semantics before continuing.
rows.rationale: Ambiguity back-routing must be enforced where resume, agency, and validation decide whether lower-loop continuation is allowed.
rows.evidence: TASK-038 acceptance explicitly requires ambiguous lower-loop cases to block and route to decision.

rows.text: Planning compiler runs as a transactional boundary: validated decision build in, proposed/created/refined tasks plus sprint metadata out, planning_build records row-to-roadmap propagation, and implementation/resume refuses tasks whose planning_build is missing, stale, failed, or blocked.
rows.rationale: Planning validation gating of implementation-ready tasks is part of promotion preflight enforcement.
rows.evidence: TASK-038 acceptance requires implementation/resume preflight to demand planning-gateway pass.

rows.text: Build a Pi Code/CodeWiki interactive decision surface that shows each decision row or generated task as an inline approval item with current state, proposed state, affected layers, risk, alternatives, and one-keystroke approve/edit/reject/defer actions. Approved rows are written through codewiki_diff_table and only then compile into decision_build.
rows.rationale: Inline approval cards are a UI/adapter feature that can ship after the hard gate semantics are defined.
rows.evidence: TASK-045 owns decision row/task candidate cards and diff-table-backed approve/edit/reject/defer actions.

rows.text: Agency becomes a bounded pipeline runner that advances loops automatically inside approved task/sprint/roadmap scope: select work, acquire artifact claims, run the required compiler, submit gateway validation, use CodeWiki-owned compaction/session reset at boundaries, stop on hard gates, and record workflow-efficiency evidence.
rows.rationale: Agency runner automation should build on SPRINT-009's hard gates and quality profile.
rows.evidence: TASK-047 owns bounded runner execution, artifact claims, gateway submission, compaction, and efficiency evidence.

rows.text: CodeWiki supports safe parallel roadmap execution through a scheduler: partition sprint/task work by write scopes, allocate role-isolated worktrees or external worker sessions, enforce artifact claims, validate immutable refs from fresh context, and serialize final merge/close through a publisher queue.
rows.rationale: Parallel scheduler/worktree/publisher orchestration is a distinct high-risk implementation unit after agency gates exist.
rows.evidence: TASK-044 owns partitioning, role worktrees/refs, fresh validation, wait/wake, and publisher queue proof.

rows.text: Define and enforce a production-ready quality profile per task/risk tier: required checks, audit profiles, review-tool thresholds, type coverage/complexity budgets or waivers, package/secret scan where applicable, implementation_build evidence, independent validation proof, and GC/archive follow-up.
rows.rationale: Production quality profile should ship with foundational gates before review remediation resumes.

sprints.title: CodeWiki vNext decision and graph workflow
sprints.outcome: Deliver the vNext operating model in bounded compatibility-safe increments, now prioritizing agent-owned session-boundary automation and workflow-efficiency friction reduction before decision_build implementation.
gates: Prioritize TASK-005 session-boundary automation/workflow-friction work before TASK-001 decision_build implementation until this accepted priority is resolved.
Keep current CodeWiki public behavior frozen except critical blocker fixes until vNext replacement flows validate.
Do not remove compatibility feedback/documentation/build/tool primitives before deprecation tests pass.
Each task must produce implementation_build and fresh validation evidence before close.

sprints.title: Decision propagation and file-structure follow-through
sprints.outcome: Prevent accepted decisions from drifting by enforcing decision-to-roadmap propagation and by giving the file-structure decision durable follow-up work.
gates: TASK-011 must land before future planning builds can be trusted to enforce complete decision propagation.
TASK-013 and TASK-014 preserve the accepted file-structure decision as durable follow-up work; they may be reprioritized after TASK-011 but must not disappear into open questions.
Each implementation task must produce implementation_build and fresh validation evidence before close.

sprints.title: Complete concept-root source migration
sprints.outcome: Finish the accepted FS-ROOT-CONCEPTS migration by moving remaining project, knowledge, change, GC, session, roadmap, state/resume, API, and shared ownership out of layer-first application/domain roots while preserving public CodeWiki behavior.
gates: Each task must compile an implementation_build before validation.
Each task must pass implementation validation before task close.
Final API/shared cleanup must prove no unapproved src/domain/** or src/application/** owner paths remain.

sprints.title: Context reset agency and graph-link hygiene
sprints.outcome: Implement approved CodeWiki reset auto-pickup, agency-level continuation, and graph-owned doc-code linking without blocking the state-root migration boundary.

sprints.title: Review signal and release hygiene
sprints.outcome: Make the PyLens/booboo review signal trustworthy and resolve low-risk package release hygiene after foundational pipeline gates are in place.
gates: decision/planning/implementation promotion gates verified before implementation
rerun static-analysis or production-readiness review subset

sprints.title: Safety and exposure-boundary cleanup
sprints.outcome: Clean Pi adapter/schema/helper exposure boundaries after foundational pipeline enforcement is stable.
gates: rerun duplicate-code, async, and boolean-param review subsets

sprints.title: State and resume hardening
sprints.outcome: Eliminate resume scheduling duplication and improve state graph/read-model typing and modularity while preserving generated outputs.
gates: rerun semantic-similarity, type-coverage, and complexity review subsets for state/resume

sprints.title: Runtime parser and support decomposition
sprints.outcome: Reduce remaining large-file complexity across knowledge parsing and project/bootstrap support flows after pipeline/agency foundations are stable.
gates: rerun complexity and fact-rules review subsets for touched roots

sprints.title: Pipeline foundation and quality gates
sprints.outcome: Make CodeWiki enforce the approved iterative compiler/gateway pipeline, inline approval flow, and production-ready quality profile before broad remediation work proceeds.
gates: decision gateway pass for pipeline hardening build
planning gateway pass for this sprint
no implementation task selected without planning-gateway proof

sprints.title: Agency automation and parallel execution
sprints.outcome: Turn agency into a bounded runner and add safe parallel scheduler/worktree/publisher orchestration after foundational gates exist.
gates: SPRINT-009 pipeline gates complete or explicitly waived by validation
fresh validation proof for parallel outputs
